mapper.insert: insert into ai_text_to_sql_run( conversation_id, source_type, original_question, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{conversationId}, #{sourceType}, #{originalQuestion}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, now(), now() ) on duplicate key update original_question = values(original_question), status = values(status), created_by = values(created_by), updated_at = now(), id = last_insert_id(id)
mapper.update: update ai_text_to_sql_run set status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, state_snapshot_json = #{stateSnapshotJson}, state_history_json = #{stateHistoryJson}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, updated_at = now() where conversation_id = #{conversationId}
update ai_text_to_sql_run set status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, updated_at = now() where conversation_id = #{conversationId}
update ai_text_to_sql_run set feedback_result = #{feedbackResult}, feedback_comment = #{feedbackComment}, feedback_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
